title: Battle of Tsuntua
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tsuntua", at revision 1370275828, opens: "The Battle of Tsuntsua, fought in December 1804, was one of the largest battles in the jihad of Usman dan Fodio." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3379716, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle in the Fulani War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
